cases.name: Breanne "Breezy" Pennington
cases.about: Courtney Robinson met Breanne, fondly known by friends as Breezy. Robinson and Breanne connected on a Facebook group for new mothers and bonded over their mutual joy and love of mac n cheese. "Thinking about Breezy and the light that she brought to that group and all of our lives. She made motherhood seem effortless. She was just a natural at it. And she was also the one who would cheer for all of us," Robinson said.
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her in the face.
